rows.input_line: Hi everyone, I'm Alex, and this is my friend Maya.
rows.output_line: Ako si Alex, at ito ang kaibigan kong si Maya.

rows.input_line: Welcome back to class. Did you all have a good weekend?
rows.output_line: Maligayang pagdating sa klase. Maganda ba ang dulo ng sanlinggo ninyo?

rows.input_line: Today let's talk about everyday plans and simple requests.
rows.output_line: Pag - usapan natin ngayon ang tungkol sa pang - araw - araw na mga plano at simpleng mga kahilingan.

rows.input_line: First, who can tell me the time? It's almost nine thirty.
rows.output_line: Una, sino ang makapagsasabi sa akin ng oras? Halos siyam na putbol na ito.

rows.input_line: My birthday falls on the twenty first of December, and I just turned thirty.
rows.output_line: Ang aking kaarawan ay pumapatak sa dalawampung unang bahagi ng Disyembre, at ako'y naging tatlumpu.

rows.input_line: Could you please pass me the notes from yesterday's meeting?
rows.output_line: Puwede mo bang ipasa sa akin ang mga nota mula sa pulong kahapon?

rows.input_line: Sure, here you go. Thanks a lot, I really appreciate it.
rows.output_line: Totoo, narito ka. Maraming salamat, talagang pinahahalagahan ko ito.

rows.input_line: The Green Valley Cooking Club meets every Saturday at the community center.
rows.output_line: Ang Green Valley Cooking Club ay nagpupulong tuwing Sabado sa sentro ng komunidad.

rows.input_line: She said he would bring his guitar, but we never saw it arrive.
rows.output_line: Sinabi niya na dadalhin ng lalaki ang gitara nito, subalit hindi namin nakita ang pagdating nito.

rows.input_line: I'm feeling a bit under the weather today, so I'll take it easy.
rows.output_line: Medyo masama ang pakiramdam ko ngayon, kaya madali lang.

rows.input_line: That joke you told earlier was hilarious. I couldn't stop laughing.
rows.output_line: Nakagigitla ang birong sinabi mo noon. Hindi ko mapigil ang pagtawa.

rows.input_line: We're running a little behind schedule, so please bear with us.
rows.output_line: Medyo nahuhuli na tayo, kaya pakisuyong pagtiisan mo kami.

rows.input_line: Take care on your way home, and see you around soon.
rows.output_line: Mag - ingat sa iyong pag - uwi, at makita ka agad.

rows.input_line: Let's catch up over lunch sometime. It's been a while since we talked.
rows.output_line: Paminsan - minsan, kumain tayo. Mula nang kami'y mag - usap.

rows.input_line: Could you speak up a little? The projector is a bit noisy today.
rows.output_line: Puwede ka bang magsalita nang kaunti? Ang projector ay medyo maingay ngayon.

rows.input_line: Alright, that's all for today. Thanks for coming, and have a great week.
rows.output_line: Alam mo, iyan ay para sa ngayon. Salamat sa inyong pagdating, at mayroon po kayong isang malaking linggo.
